metadata.description: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
metadata.name: dsh-mac-notify

paragraphs.text: macOS desktop notifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener run
tifications for dsh events, delivered over SSH to a small notifier HTTP listener running on the Mac.
监听 DSH 事件（任务完成、会话暂停、子agent结束、workflow完成），通过 SSH 在 Mac 上显示 terminal-notifier 悬浮气泡通知
- DSH_MAC_NOTIFY_SSH - SSH target of the Mac that shows notifications, e.g. user@mac.local. Required
; notifications are skipped when unset. Key-based auth must work non-interactively (BatchMode).
The plugin posts notifications over SSH to a small HTTP listener on the Mac (127.0.0.1:18923). Run t
he bundled example on the Mac:
It requires terminal-notifier (brew install terminal-notifier). Port and notifier binary are configu
rable via NOTIFY_PORT / NOTIFIER_BIN. For permanence, wrap it in a LaunchAgent.
